story_zh: 原始部落的元首曾预言灾难，但舆论认为他愚蠢。他斩钉截铁地约束欲望，预先准备。果然，灾难来临，人们遭受遭殃。他运用原理，使部落愈合并增添力量。原先的愚昧变成圆满的智慧，这源于对真理的在意。
story_pinyin: Yuánshǐ bùluò de yuánshǒu céng yùyán zāinàn, dàn yúlùn rènwéi tā yúchǔn. Tā zhǎndīngjiétiě de yuēshù yùwàng, yùxiān zhǔnbèi. Guǒrán, zāinàn láilín, rénmen zāoshòu zāoyāng. Tā yùnyòng yuánlǐ, shǐ bùluò yùhé bìng zēngtiān lìliàng. Yuánxiān de yúmèi biànchéng yuánmǎn de zhìhuì, zhè yuányú duì zhēnlǐ de zàiyì.
story_en: The head of a primitive tribe once predicted a calamity, but public opinion deemed him foolish. He resolutely bound his desires and prepared beforehand. Indeed, the disaster came, and people underwent suffering. He operated on theory, helping the tribe recover and increase strength. The former benightedness became complete wisdom, stemming from minding the truth.
